name: @compmd/processor
description: The CompMD processor as WebAssembly: parses, validates and expands a CompMD document in the browser.

scripts.wasm: cargo build --profile wasm --target wasm32-unknown-unknown -p compmd-wasm && wasm-bindgen --target web --out-dir pkg ../target/wasm32-unknown-unknown/wasm/compmd_wasm.wasm
